Line ranges, rename follow, and an API cache. This is the v0.2 milestone from the [roadmap](https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/blob/v0.2.0/ROADMAP.md).

## Added
- **Line ranges.** `linelore path/to/file.py:10-30` blames every line in the range, **deduplicates commits** (the same sha appears once even when it owns many lines), and prints the lore for each unique commit in first-appearance order. `--json` adds `"range": {"start", "end"}` and a `"commits"` array (`blame`, `lines`, `pulls`, `notes` per commit). Single-line `FILE:LINE` output is unchanged.
- **Follow moves and renames.** Blame now runs with `git blame -C -M`, so lore follows code across renames and copies.
- **API response cache.** Lookups are cached in memory for the process and on disk under `~/.cache/linelore` (or `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/linelore`), keyed by API host + request so repeating the same sha does not re-hit GitHub. Override the directory with `LINELORE_CACHE=/path`, or set `LINELORE_CACHE=off` to disable disk caching.
- **Promote Fixes/Closes/Resolves.** When GraphQL `closingIssuesReferences` is empty (seen on some older PRs such as requests#4371), `Fixes` / `Closes` / `Resolves #N` in the PR title or body are promoted into the fixes list instead of staying as plain mentions.

## Install
```bash
pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore@v0.2.0
# or
pip install https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/releases/download/v0.2.0/linelore-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

Python 3.9+, no dependencies. Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Blackman99/linelore/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md)
